blocks.text: Digital maeeshat (economy) mein cryptocurrencies aham hain kyunke yeh paisa badalne ka mehfooz aur decentralized tareeqa deti hain. Bankon ki jaari ki hui riwayati raqam ke bar-aks, cryptocurrencies blockchain technology se transactions ko mehfooz aur shaffaf rakhti hain. Yeh technology transactions ko aise record karti hai ke unhein badla na ja sake, aur kisi darmiyani (middleman) ki zaroorat nahi parti.

Bitcoin, Ethereum aur doosri cryptocurrencies se log jaldi aur kam kharche mein paisa bhej sakte hain, sarhadon ke paar bhi. Yeh un logon ko bhi aalami maeeshat mein shamil hone mein madad deti hain jin ke paas bank ki sahoolat nahi. Kitab ke mutabiq cryptocurrency transactions private aur mehfooz hain kyunke in mein zaati maloomat (personal information) nahi maangi jati aur yeh cryptography se mehfooz hoti hain.

blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein
blocks.text: 'Private' ka matlab yahan yeh hai ke transaction ke liye naam ya shanakhti card nahi chahiye. Lekin Bitcoin jaise blockchain par har transaction ek address (khaas code) ke saath sab ke saamne record hoti hai; naam nazar nahi aata magar len den sab dekh sakte hain. Is ko 'pseudonymous' (farzi naam wala) kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Cryptocurrencies ka ek faida aur ek khatra bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Faida: bank ke baghair, sarhad ke paar bhi, tez aur sasti muntaqili. Khatra: in ki qeemat tezi se oopar neeche hoti hai, aur agar key (password jaisi khufia cheez) kho jaye ya dhoka ho jaye to paisa wapas nahi milta.

items: Cryptocurrencies: blockchain par decentralized, mehfooz aur shaffaf len den (Bitcoin, Ethereum).
Tez, sasti, sarhad paar; bank na rakhne walon ke liye bhi.
